name: agent
title: Agent transport
description: Reaches a channel through a local agent harness — how Gmail and Slack are read today.

connector.label: Connector
connector.hint: This is the CHANNEL, and half of every thread key. Required — an empty or unknown connector parks the source on config_error.

harness.label: Harness
harness.hint: The worker CLI that runs the fetch. Without a launchable one the source parks on config_error.

segments.label: Segments
segments.placeholder: INBOX — or channel IDs (C…) for slack
segments.hint: What to walk, one cursor each: mailboxes/labels for gmail (defaults to INBOX), channel IDs for slack (required — a channel id cannot be guessed).

send_agent.label: Send agent
send_agent.hint: The persona that writes a reply. Empty means the connector's own (`emailer` for gmail, `slack-poster` for slack).

send_subagent.label: Send subagent
send_subagent.hint: Empty means the connector's own (`email_sender` for gmail, `slack_sender` for slack).

deadline_seconds.label: Fetch deadline (seconds)
deadline_seconds.hint: Wall-clock for one fetch; a worker past it is killed so it cannot hold the source's slot forever.

send_deadline_seconds.label: Send deadline (seconds)
send_deadline_seconds.hint: Wall-clock for one send — shorter than a fetch: a fetch may sweep a mailbox, a send writes one message.

stream.label: Stream (legacy)
stream.hint: A single segment; read only when `segments` and `streams` are empty. Prefer `segments`.

streams.label: Streams (legacy)
streams.hint: Older alias of `segments`; read only when `segments` is empty. Prefer `segments`.
